title: AgentSkillsCommandRegistry
description: Registry schema for slash commands across agent runtimes (Claude Code, Pi, Antigravity/Gemini)

name.description: Unique slash command name (kebab-case, e.g. adr, review, c4)

skill.description: Name of the backing skill directory in skills/

title.description: Display title for the command and documentation

description.description: Concise description of what the command does

default_action.description: Action description used in fallback prompt when invoked without arguments

alias_skill.description: Whether to generate an alias skill in skills/<name>/SKILL.md for Antigravity (default: true if name != skill)

instructions.description: Core instructions or tenets to embed in the command prompt and alias skill

prompt_template.description: Optional custom prompt template for Claude Code command
